<!-- title: Curses | updated: 2025-03-11T12:20:22Z | cats:  -->
Curses are a collection of debuffs that are found throughout the game,  guaranteed in cursed chests as well as certain key rooms. Although mostly seen as a nuisance during runs, they can become quite useful under certain circumstances. For example, in combination with certain [[Relics]] that grant buffs for having curses. Some heroes actually find several of the curses to be quite desirable for their effects.

== Trivia ==
- Brutal Reproduction can activate on the [[Author]] fight, as it is not counted as a Boss or Elite, causing the player to fight against 2 Authors.

- Bombs created by Minefield can break the metal boxes found in the Second level.
